_comment: Hand-maintained Week-1 starting quarterbacks for 2026. An entry with starter:true blends that QB's projection base toward the league starter baseline (median PPG of QBs with 14+ games last season), weighted w = g25/(g25+6). It ONLY fires for a QB who played fewer than 8 games in 2025 and has prior NFL history — true rookies are excluded because the rookie branch already covers them. Effects: projected PPG only. DELTA Score, model value and verdict are untouched. Pre-flight in scripts/freeze-snapshot.js aborts on a name that does not resolve, is not a QB, or does not reach the engine. Keys beginning with underscore are ignored. Names must match RAW exactly. Verified against the 32-team Week-1 list on 7 September 2026, before the accuracy-ledger freeze.
_not_flagged: Twelve other QBs met the eligibility rule (under 8 games in 2025, prior NFL history) but are not Week 1 starters and are deliberately absent: Davis Mills, Kenny Pickett, Tyrod Taylor, Mason Rudolph, Tyler Huntley, Gardner Minshew, Joe Milton, Tanner McKee, Trey Lance, Jameis Winston, Anthony Richardson, Tyson Bagent. Kansas City and Atlanta named their starters on 7 Sep 2026 — Patrick Mahomes and Tua Tagovailoa. Both played 14 games in 2025 and Michael Penix Jr. played 9, all above the 8-game threshold, so the rule cannot fire for any of them and no entry is warranted. Recorded here so a future reader does not re-derive it.

Jayden Daniels.note: Established starter. Missed 10 games in 2025 with various injuries; 7 games played. Confirmed Week-1 starter.

Kyler Murray.note: Traded to Minnesota this offseason and named the starter over J.J. McCarthy. 5 games in 2025.

Malik Willis.note: Signed 3yr/$67.5M with Miami and is the clear QB1. 4 games in 2025 as the Green Bay backup.
